# Social Stats

> Social Stats is an open-source, self-hostable social media management platform for agencies and teams. It publishes to Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Google Business from one composer, runs many client workspaces with enforced tenant isolation, and adds analytics, a unified inbox, WhatsApp bots and an AI assistant. Django + React, MIT.

Social Stats is an open alternative to Hootsuite, Buffer and Sprout Social, built and maintained by Gigai Kripa Services (https://gigaikripaservices.com/social-stats/). The full text of these docs is at https://cbsshekhawat18-lab.github.io/social-stats-social-media-manager/llms-full.txt.

Key facts (version 2.0.0, released 2026-11-13):
- Repository: https://github.com/cbsshekhawat18-lab/social-stats-social-media-manager
- License: MIT, free to self-host.
- Stack: Django 5.2 LTS, Django REST Framework, Celery and Redis, Django Channels, PostgreSQL (SQLite for local development), React 18.
- Run it: Docker Compose with prebuilt amd64 and arm64 images on GHCR, or by hand with Python 3.11 to 3.13, Node 18 and Redis.
- Demo data: `python manage.py demo_setup` seeds three accounts and 90 days of sample analytics.
- Counted in the 2.0.0 code: 400 backend tests (all passing), 93 data models, 388 API endpoints, 52 background tasks, 15 scheduled jobs.
- AI features use Anthropic Claude with your own API key; everything else works without one.
- Status: early-stage; it runs end to end but has no launch partners yet.
